Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move into the pilot phase. Procurement asked me to surface a short technical checklist we can use to close the commercial side this week:

- Org setup and admin contact for SSO/KMS
- API key issuance and test tokens for staging
- IP allowlist range(s) for our egress
- VPC peering window and any cross-account VPC requirements
- Expected cutover date and rollback window

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a pre-signed MAP we can share with legal? Also attaching a quick network sketch they asked for (attached).

Claire

ClearBridge Health

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pre-close technical check-in: API keys, org setup, firewall & peering

Claire — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together the items below to make the MAP playbook actionable for your infra and procurement teams.

Summary of next steps (short):
1) Org setup: Please share the email address for the Redwood org admin (we support SSO / SCIM). We can pre-create the org and reserve your org slug once we have that contact.
2) API keys: We will issue two scoped API keys for staging: a long-lived test key for integration and a short-lived key for webhooks. We’ll publish token naming and rotation guidance in the MAP doc.
3) IP allowlist: Provide your egress ranges (CIDR). If you don’t have stable egress ranges, we can accept an allowlist to our staging endpoints during the pilot window instead.
4) VPC peering: We support two options — AWS VPC peering (account-to-account) or PrivateLink. For peering we’ll need the VPC ID and a 1-hour window for route table validation.
5) Cutover: Proposed: Nov 12 — Nov 13 (UTC). We’ll hold a 2-hour blackout window for verification with rollback plan.

I attached a draft MAP (CBH-MAP-v1.pdf) with these items and a proposed schedule. Marissa will own the cutover coordination; Sean will handle SLA and billing alignment.

Can you confirm the org admin and the CIDR ranges by end of day Wednesday so we can lock the MAP?

— Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: CBH-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Claire — looping in the ops steps and timeline you can paste into a change ticket.

Technical validation checklist (for your infra team):
- Provide org admin SSO invite email (we have michael.huang@clearbridge.health) — we’ll send SCIM invite when you confirm SSO provider.
- API keys: we’ll create staging:staging_integration_key (long-lived, read/write), staging:webhook_key (rotating) — rotation policy documented in MAP.
- IP allowlist: add 54.182.0.0/16 and 3.120.0.0/14 to staging allowlist; we will also provide an ephemeral rollout token if you prefer temporary access.
- VPC peering validation: plan a 60-minute validation window for route propagation and test requests; ops will run smoke tests and verify KV cache persistence.
- Cutover rollback: snapshot configuration and rollback playbook — immediate revert target 30 minutes.

Proposed schedule (UTC):
- Nov 11 22:00 — pre-seed keys + staging smoke tests (Redwood)
- Nov 12 02:00 — VPC peering establish + route table validation (60m)
- Nov 12 03:30 — integration tests and token rotation check (30m)
- Nov 12 04:15 — go/no-go decision; if green we proceed to pilot traffic.

We’ll add these to the MAP PDF and share a final version for your legal to attach to the SOW. If procurement confirms DocuSign this afternoon we can align signatures and hit the proposed dates.

— Marissa Cole
POC Program Manager | Redwood Inference
